name: Telos
description: The Telos Robotic Platform is an endovascular robotic and telerobotic system developed by [Imperative Care](/company/imperative_care) (through its Telos Health business unit) for aspiration thrombectomy in acute ischemic stroke and vascular interventions. The platform combines a bedside robotic catheter and guidewire manipulation unit with a physician control console engineered for both on-site catheterization laboratory operation and remote telerobotic procedures.

urls.caption: Proximie & Imperative Care Robotic Stroke Partnership (2025)

lifecycle.note: In premarket development under Imperative Care's Telos Health division for local and remote telerobotic aspiration thrombectomy in acute ischemic stroke; not yet cleared for commercial sale.
